name: Remote Sessions
subtitle: Claude Code from your phone
promotionalText: See every Claude Code conversation on your computer, read where each one is, and pick any of them back up from your phone with Remote Control.
shortDescription: See your Claude Code conversations and resume any of them from your phone.
description:
Remote Sessions puts every Claude Code conversation on your computer in your pocket.

Open the app to see all your sessions, grouped by project and sorted by when you last used them. Tap one to read its latest messages, and tap Connect to resume it on your computer with Remote Control: it opens in the Claude app, ready to keep going from wherever you are.

HOW IT WORKS
• Install the free remote-sessions server on your computer with one command (macOS, Linux or Windows).
• Scan the QR code it shows. That's it.
• To use it away from home, add Tailscale on both devices.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your conversations travel encrypted straight from your computer to your phone. There are no accounts, no cloud and no analytics.
• Pairing pins your computer's certificate, so only your phone gets in and nobody can impersonate your computer.
• The server is open source.

FEATURES
• All your Claude Code conversations, with search and a project filter
• The latest messages of each one, including which tools Claude used
• One tap to resume a conversation with Remote Control
• Several computers, found again automatically on your network
• A demo mode to try it without a computer

REQUIREMENTS
Claude Code on your computer, logged in with a Claude subscription (Remote Control doesn't work with an API key), and the Claude app to continue the conversation.

Remote Sessions is not an official Anthropic app. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic.
